name: No skill (control)
note: Claude with no design skill. Every other page is read against this one.

name: frontend-design
note: Anthropic's own skill and the most installed of the group. Pushes Claude to commit to an aesthetic direction before writing code.

name: ui-ux-pro-max
note: A searchable library of styles, palettes and font pairings that produces a design system first.

name: taste-skill
note: Rules aimed at overriding the generic look of LLM-made frontends. Its bundled scripts were not run, so its random layout picks were made by hand from its own lists.

name: impeccable
note: Paul Bakaus's skill, built around craft, critique and polish. The run included two code reviews by a second agent, as the skill prescribes.

name: web-design-guidelines
note: A review skill, not a generator. This page is a copy of the control that the skill audited and fixed, so the numbers cover the audit only.

name: ui-styling
note: shadcn/ui components and Tailwind conventions. The components were written by hand inside the page's folder.

name: ckw-design
note: A multi-part skill: design thinking, system, spatial layout and visual philosophy. The only run that rendered its own page and had the screenshots reviewed before finishing.

name: emil-design-eng
note: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skill, weighted towards animation and small interaction details.

name: shadcn
note: The official shadcn/ui skill. A component-library approach instead of aesthetic guidance, with components generated by the shadcn CLI.
